stemMd: Which statement best captures the passage's point?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Raising the square eliminated all flooding.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Accurate memories of a changed landmark can support misleading conclusions about a wider area.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Residents deliberately invented the dry square.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Oral accounts should never be used.

explanationMd: The central distinction is between a true local observation and an overgeneralisation. The landmark changed, so it no longer served as a stable proxy for town-wide flood conditions.

distractorRationale.c: The passage says their recollection was accurate.
distractorRationale.e: The engineer incorporates them with other evidence.
